svg.aria-label: The production readiness rubric the product scores on itself: six of nine dimensions shipped — evals, regression gate, learning loop, tracing, cost and release; two partial — the LLM judge and guardrails; one designed only — the scale path.
svg.title: Six of nine shipped, scored by the product on itself

g.title: the learning half, R1 to R4 — how a version gets better without getting worse
R1 evals and golden set · shipped · a committed manifest, train 100 and gate 100 reports, and prediction CSVs for every run
R2 LLM-as-judge · partial · a Haiku 4.5 confidence band scored once on the sealed split, not adopted as a gate
R3 regression gate · shipped · net positive and one-sided cluster-corrected McNemar p below 0.05
R4 learning loop · shipped · campaigns of at most five experiments, one agent's prompt rewritten per experiment
the operating half, R5 to R9 — what happens once it is live, and who finds out first
R5 guardrails and security · partial · abuse controls only, with no per-user auth and no red-team suite
R6 observability and tracing · shipped · every LLM call is a span, and every served turn a row
R7 cost tracking and control · shipped · per-turn cost with prices declared in code
R8 deploy and release · shipped · merge to CI to OIDC deploy, with a smoke test that asserts the served bundle
R9 scale path · designed only · rung 10, one instance, sessions in process memory, no load test
the score is computed by the product from evaluation/readiness.json and served at its own admin console, measured 2026-09-08 — the same six of nine this page's scorecard reports
